answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the ridge count is verified against the signal text itself, the fable audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 24 aliases therefore means producing 24 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
